about_the_game:
Neon Colony

Neon Colony is a tower defense game where you develop a reasonably uninhabited planet for your kind corporate benefactors. Plan your roads, extract the planet's resources and deal with any unruly and most definitively evil aliens in a diplomatic manner.

Game features

  • Build your own road! Each new road tile can be rotated and replaced as you see fit to gain full control over the planet's surface - though replacing comes at a cost.

  • Discover more valuable resources further from your city, but also more dangerous enemies. 

  • Use your resources to power advanced towers - unless you would rather sell them for intergalactic credits, which can be used to buy one of the 100+ upgrades to your towers, city or economy.

  • Deal with alien ruins and artifacts that can drastically change the nature of a run.

  • Unlock and choose one of 15 governors to govern your colony, each with unique advantages and downsides.

  • There is a challenge to each run, which can start with 1-4 lanes, depending on your level of greed and with 15 levels determining how hospitable the planet is.

  • Easy to learn, with 5 optional tutorial levels that gradually introduce the game elements to you.

  • Play as you want! Finishing a run does not require meta-progression, with all essential upgrades available from the start.

Music by Karl Casey @ White Bat Audio

Background images made with Craiyon

short_description: Neon Colony is an isometric tower defense game where you build your own road to access and harvest the resources of an alien planet. Deal with the resistance of the local population and fulfill this noble mission for your generous corporate benefactors.
